narrative.intro: Black Construction Tutor Perini is a federal contractor with $710M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Black Construction Tutor Perini won 14 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $50.7M and obligations up 448.3% year over year. Black Construction Tutor Perini received most of its FY2026 obligations in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, which accounts for $703M of obligations. Black Construction Tutor Perini also recorded $7.2M in New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders) obligations for FY2026 to date. Black Construction Tutor Perini’s obligations vary by year, with reported totals of $98.5M in FY21, $286M in FY22, $71.2M in FY23, $228M in FY24, and $129M in FY25. Black Construction Tutor Perini’s current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date, and the note indicates award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.
